body:
Being a long time codeine user its been losing its bang through the times. I figured that using it with a benzo would get things back to my first experience. So I downed one and a half bottles of generic cough syrup sold in these parts. It contains 10mg codeine,30mg pseudoephedrine and 1.5mg triprolidine all these per 5ml in a 100 ml bottle. The effects of the syrup began and after 45min I felt the peak. This is when I swallowed the benzos 4 of them each  1.5mg. I then began reading a copy of naked lunch on my computer. After half an hour my head hit the keyboard and I felt what can only be described as nirvana. Feelings of warmth engulfed my being as the drugs worked their magic. I must have passed out coz I woke 3hrs later not being able to breath properly. It was good stuff imo.
